summary: Completed a small consistency step with the remaining budget rather than starting work I could not finish: the identity finding's durable knowledge entry now carries the same usage anchor as the account I corrected last turn — its sources gained the crate's own example (examples/kv_store_async/src/main.rs:133-150, where the call exists for 'a specific entry whose durability the caller must confirm synchronously' and the resolved index is printed as 'durably decided at log idx ... safe to announce') — while its statement, conditions and cited executions (receipt 743518e2, event 1) are unchanged, so no body was gratuitously rewritten. Nothing else moved. Final position as the budget closes: four findings stand with their receipts, knowledge and scoped limits — (1) the actor layer's event egress parks the loop and, once enough nodes park, the cluster stops deciding (receipts ff4511e8, 76557a28, bbff5b4c; capacities 8/64/1024; corrected per-destination transport; 21.69s retrospective bound; the superseded transport-jam run kept as an excluded cause); (2) the core has no timer-driven repair for a lost Accepted reply, measured at two and three nodes with quorum-critical losses and only heartbeats on the wire afterwards (receipts 092538c6, 9f3f25cc; one accounting question closed by explanation); (3) append_notify can resolve Ok for an index occupied by another entry, bounded by measurement to entries the following leader did not adopt, with the adopted case shown truthful (receipts 743518e2, 78c53df3); and (4) the actor layer owns the instance but offers no compaction path, with the panic-to-Shutdown attribution chain and the repository's compaction documentation as the norm (source-settled). The one declared unfinished measurement remains the failure side of that last finding — a Storage whose write returns Err driven through the actor — which needs a delegating Storage wrapper that did not fit the remaining per-turn budget.
